long_biography.plain_text:
Ross Reid Contractors began with a single bulldozer bought from founder Ross Reid's winnings as a midget-car racer. Clayton Reid entered the company's formal leadership in 1987 and later became its managing director. The family business developed from that earthmoving base into an Auckland civil contractor handling subdivisions, roads, drainage and major infrastructure work.

During Reid's long tenure, the group assembled more than 400 items of heavy plant for bulk earthworks and land-development projects. He also became a director and owner of Highgate Business Park, extending his activities from contracting into commercial and residential development. Highgate has pursued a large mixed-use site at Silverdale.
